physical_service.equation: Same accepted original curved ten-node P2 linear-elastic four-positive-quadrature approximation in physical mm/MPa, with the actual compatible SPC/RBE2/free reduction and RBE3 loads; not exact OptiStruct settings/integration
physical_service.acceleration: Fresh combined P1-derived Galerkin additive preconditioner only: full masked P, Ac=P^TAP, fine block-Jacobi plus P Sc P^T; Sc is zero-start fixed32 scalar-diagonal Jacobi with omega=1/Gamma, Gamma=max absolute row-sum of diag(Ac)^(-1/2) Ac diag(Ac)^(-1/2). No direct-Ac low-fidelity solution, no adaptive inner iteration, parameter sweep or test fallback.
physical_service.algorithm_reference: notes/geobc_elastic_coarse_plan.json and its accepted five-CAD extension; exact source SHA and current accepted recipe are to be bound in the final protocol
physical_service.guards: Each new CAD receives its own input/operator/geometry/preconditioner necessary guards once in the actual service build. Prior CAD guards/hashes do not certify new data. No duplicate resource/toy/preflight stage.
physical_service.allN_recovery: Restore fixed nodes at their actual zero constraints and unused loaded-reference outputs via verified original derived H map. Preserve the original H5 vertex order and full N including reference nodes; do not silently omit them.

query_protocol.all_original_nodes: Persist signed uXYZ[N,3] mm, and selected signed-S[N] MPa only if a qualified S route was frozen; full H5 node order with GRID mapping and finite masks.
query_protocol.native_full_cell_queries: Every original cell, original cell-row order, four ordered positive tetrahedron Gauss barycentrics a=(5+3sqrt(5))/20,b=(5-sqrt(5))/20; use all ten P2 nodes. Persist curved physical X, U and G=du/dX in FP64. G=sum_i U_i tensor grad_X N_i, J[c,r]=sum_i X_i,c dN_i/dr, solve J^T grad_XN=grad_rN; physical mm derivative, no normalized derivative or corner-P1 surrogate.
query_protocol.bounded_physical_coordinate_queries: Reuse the accepted deterministic selector: <=32 original cells and <=8 conforming shared faces, two interior barycentrics [0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4]/[0.4,0.3,0.2,0.1], shared-face [1/3,1/3,1/3]/[0.2,0.3,0.5]. Locate physical points without oracle barycentrics on the fixed selected-cell scope. No result-based resampling.
query_protocol.geometry_and_replay: Pin existing continuous-query geometry/implementation-policy tolerances and explicit ambiguous-root/invalid-J/fold outcomes. Original midside conformity required. Negative orientation policies must follow the physical operator's actual positive-J requirement. One-sided face gradients need not agree; no C1 requirement.
query_protocol.continuous_S_if_enabled: Define S_h(X)=sum_i N_i(X) predicted_node_S_i on the same curved TET10 element. This interpolates the already-predicted signed nodal field and is not a claim to reproduce the original solver's continuous scalar, sign or nodal recovery. Do not instead evaluate the learned tensor head at off-node tensor values without a separately frozen definition.
query_protocol.GT_proxy: After the label barrier only, apply the same all-ten P2 interpolation/physical gradient to aligned original nodal U, and the same P2 interpolation to original signed nodal S when permitted. These are node-derived reference proxies, never strain/stress tensor GT or a source continuous-field truth.
query_protocol.scope_limit: No global unique inverse, arbitrary whole-CAD locator speed, C1 continuity, PDE certification or raw-CAD meshing claim.

prediction_barrier_and_labels.barrier: All five fullN predictions, native U/G query outputs, bounded-query identities/results and per-CAD numerical convergence/finite receipts must commit before any original test U/S target value is read. Include continuous S predictions if enabled. Verify exact frozen endpoint/source/scaler identities in the barrier.
prediction_barrier_and_labels.failed_case_policy: Unsupported input, numerical failure, nonfinite output, missing query coverage or budget-negative remains one of five. Never replace or drop it. If all-five barrier fails, open no test target; report capability/cost failures with accuracy null and preserve all still-sealed labels.
prediction_barrier_and_labels.label_source: Official Field/<CAD>.csv in its GRID/coordinate row identity; select only the frozen ver columns. Apply the precommitted one-to-one coordinate permutation into H5 rows. H5 targets are not a second oracle; no raw field/vertex order assumption.
prediction_barrier_and_labels.once_per_case: One deferred original target parse per CAD, obtaining U and S together only in the qualified complete branch; U-only parse never materializes any S column. Commit owned label/metric caches and actual attempted/completed counters. Technical read failure is explicit, never silently repeated.
prediction_barrier_and_labels.immutable_labels: Preserve original signed components and original signed scalar; no abs/sign correction, q replacement, VM reconstruction, calibration, target resampling or solver-reference substitution.
prediction_barrier_and_labels.geometry_input_reads: Coordinate-only CSV, H5 vertices/cells and deck parsing are input reads with separate receipts; they are not to be disguised as zero sealed-file access after actual release.
prediction_barrier_and_labels.FNO_reference_addendum: If the optional single frozen FNO reference is adopted, fair_blind_barrier in FNO_independent_reference requires both arms all5 fields before the one shared U/S target parse. Physical native-query outputs are separately required; FNO does not gain a native-gradient claim.

metrics_and_interpretation.node_metrics: Per-CAD and fixed-five mean/worst U vector relativeL2/RMSmm/max vector error; qualified signed-S relativeL2/RMSE_MPa/MAE_MPa/max and topceil1% absolute-original-S-GT hotspot. Stable descending abs then original-row ascending ties.
metrics_and_interpretation.query_metrics: Full-fourQ positive-volume-weighted U/G relativeL2 and absolute RMS/max, plus same-P2 S proxy scores if enabled. Report node and query scopes separately; no old P1 metric or nodal score transferred to P2 queries.
metrics_and_interpretation.zero_reference: Zero reference energy yields null relative score with explicit zero flag and absolute metrics; no artificial denominator floor or automatic pass.
metrics_and_interpretation.gate_status: These are proposed blind thresholds, not existing accepted criteria or engineering tolerances. Root must accept or replace them before any new-field parse, then no post-test retuning. Report continuous-S proxy descriptively rather than inventing an unvalidated source-continuous-S gate.
metrics_and_interpretation.not_a_neural_ranking: Full-FE physics has input connectivity/material/BC and per-request solving costs absent in pointcloud-only learned routes. This single blind test evaluates the selected service, not a same-capacity family ranking.
metrics_and_interpretation.after_test: No performance-based route/seed/normalizer/head/coarse correction on these five. Any future development using their evidence needs an independent unused evaluation set; retain this failed or passed trial permanently.

Acquisition and upstream CAD meshing excluded explicitly; all source/setup costs charged rather than borrowed from old CAD receipts.
proposed_budget_and_fresh_cost.accounting: Single-request full checkpoint load charged per independent cold request; campaign shared/batch reuse disclosed separately. No geometry/operator rebuild or committed prediction/label reread unless a declared technical repair with receipts is necessary. Do not reset budgets.
proposed_budget_and_fresh_cost.no_value_for_missing: Budget-negative or unsupported cases keep null metric/cost components and explicit reason. Finite finalization overshoot disclosed; it does not reopen target access or grant convergence.

The existing service source is pinned to its oldDEV2 prepared archives; a new blind wrapper must reuse its narrow inference helpers, not call the old service run/request_contract with fabricated records or bypass its scope.

information_and_cold_accounting.fresh_request_rule: Measure each arm as its own fresh combined raw-original-mesh/deck-to-output request, including actual input/schema construction, source alignment, startup/CUDA, source/scaler/checkpoint load, geometry/cloud/grid or operator/preconditioner, inference/solve/query/persistence. fair_blind_barrier.required: Both preselected arms must persist all5 finite fullN U predictions in the same original-node identity, plus the physical route native queries; if a qualified complete-S route is selected, both also persist all5 signed-S predictions. Freeze all10 node fields and source/endpoint identities before shared target reads.
fair_blind_barrier.shared_GT: Read each original test/ver U once; read each original signed-S once only in the qualified complete-S branch, then compute both arms metrics from that same owned aligned cache. GT reads5 per member, not5 per arm; actual attempts/repairs counted.
fair_blind_barrier.no_S_unlock_by_FNO: A historically frozen FNO signed-S output alone does not bypass the physical-route complete-S eligibility rule. In U-only branch no new S target is opened or scored, even if FNO returns4 channels.
fair_blind_barrier.failure: Any unavailable reference, unsupported full-FE case, nonfinite or incomplete fixed5 barrier is a terminal inventory failure with null accuracy, no deleted/replaced CAD and no hidden single-arm fallback. Root can preregister a different independent partial-service scope before parsing, not after seeing test results.
fair_blind_barrier.comparison: Use fixed5 per-case mean/worst/absolute errors and true request cost; report FNO-U versus physics-U and qualified S only. Native physical gradient is a separate capability, not a causal victory over an unimplemented FNO derivative API. Do not test-select a seed or revise either route from the blind results.
